entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Will I really be able to kill the Phantom[n]Thieves if I take that!?

entries.speaker: Researcher
entries.en: Temporarily collapsing a Palace will[n]take down anyone inside it as well.

entries.speaker: Researcher
entries.en: The abrupt nature of the collapse means[n]they will be unable to escape without[n]extreme luck.

entries.speaker: Researcher
entries.en: However, the only way to purposely[n]erase a cognitive world is by halting[n]biological activity.

entries.speaker: Researcher
entries.en: In other words, this medicine will[n]temporarily kill you. There are great[n]risks involved...

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Anything will do! Give it to me!

entries.speaker: Private Doctor
entries.en: W-We must be sure to transfer him[n]at once if anything goes wrong!
